warnings: This house (บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_07) belongs to the บ้านต้านภัยพิบัติแผ่นดินไหว (earthquake-resistant house) sub-series, which has only 2 designs (แบบที่ 1, แบบที่ 2) -- distinct from the 10-design บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย series seen in houses #1-#5/#8-#10 of this project, which uses the same series_price_table[] shape but with 10 rows under design names 'บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย 1'..'10'. Two different DPT (กรมโยธาธิการและผังเมือง) 'บ้านสานฝัน' publication sub-series, each internally consistent, not to be merged or cross-numbered.

Design 2 (158 ตร.ม., ฐานรากเสาเข็ม 2,155,000 บาท, ฐานรากแผ่ 2,036,000 บาท) matches this house's own BOQ header text ('บ้านต้านภัยพิบัติแผ่นดินไหว แบบ 2 ชั้น (ฐานรากเสาเข็ม ไม่มีระบบปรับอากาศ)', หน้า78-88) exactly -- confirms this house IS แบบที่ 2 of this sub-series.

Unlike the 10-design series' equivalent pages in other houses (which split a pure price-table page from a pure image-cover page), this page combines both a render image and size/price data for each of the 2 designs on the same page -- there is no separate image-only cover page in this sub-series' 2-page pair (หน้า91/หน้า92 below), so no separate elements[]/catalog_entry structure was needed here.

This page (หน้า91, grayscale/print-oriented colour scheme) and the following page (หน้า92, colour/digital-oriented scheme, extracted separately as its own file since it is a distinct source_image) print near-identical content -- same 2 designs, same sizes, same prices, same renders, different background colour treatment. All 4 price figures were cross-verified at 3x zoom against both pages independently and agree exactly, giving high confidence in the numbers despite the low-contrast grayscale rendering on this specific page.

No printed page number is visible on this cover-style page -- doc_page recorded as null, matching the convention already established for the equivalent series-cover page in other houses of this project (e.g. house #4's หน้า94).
